{"children":[["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"Key Figure Leaving Popular Local Restaurant"}]]}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"By Shannon Howell"}]]}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"MELBOURNE (4 June) ― After 23 years of preparing mouth-watering dishes at the Sundown Bistro on Tenth Street, Terry Lonegan has stepped down as head chef to focus on becoming a travel writer and photographer."}]]}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"This is just one of several changes that have "}],["text",{"value":"recently occurred at the popular eatery, known for its delicious food and large outdoor dining patio."}]]}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"Since the restaurant announced its decision to serve only vegetarian dishes late last year, founder and general manager Jack Braynard has retired, and se"}],["text",{"value":"veral cooks and servers have moved to other restaurants in Melbourne."}]]}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"Current general manager Jesper Olson has recently confirmed that Paula Tarrant has been hired to take over and run things in the kitchen."}]]}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0}],["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"“We’re looking ahead and anticipate bright thi"}],["text",{"value":"ngs for our future,” said Mr. Olson. “Paula plans to introduce many of her signature dishes, and we’re sure our diners will enjoy them.”"}]]}]]}
